scope: Pinned source classes with simulated GPIO/SPI, board detection and time; not physical acceptance
transportCases: real SPI class: carrier output pins, mode 0 / 10 MHz, HOTHMI init, inversion, right-edge RGBW bytes
real button class and LVGL polling: all eight pull-up inputs, press/release, 5/10 ms initial bounce and release chatter
gpioSelection: Bank-label aliases; cdev enumeration is not assumed
gpioAliasRegression: Sparse and reordered devices plus upstream gpiochip4 symlink; metadata-only resolution
